LineChange.description: Content one line has and another doesn't, or has in another state.

file.description:
The file its mark is in, from the project root, as `ascribe check`
reports it.

from_state.description:
The state in `from`, for a change of state: a lifecycle state, such
as `preview`, or `ga`.

heading.description:
The heading it's under, or the section's own heading; absent at the
top of the page, and for a page.

kind.description:
What the mark is on: `page` (the frontmatter's `available`),
`section` (a heading's), `block` (the block after it), or `row` (a
table row's).

page.description: The page's title, or the file's path when it has none.

to_state.description: The state in `to`, for a change of state.

description: What differs between two lines of one target.

added.description: What `to` has and `from` doesn't, in page order.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

changed.description: What both have, in a different state.

from.description: The line compared from, as the list writes it.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

title: VersionsChangesReport
